definitions.explanation: Materials or substances that can be used for economic benefit or to sustain life.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{天然|てんねん}{資源|しげん}に{乏|とぼ}しい。
examples.english: Japan is poor in natural resources.

examples.japanese: {限|かぎ}りある{資源|しげん}を{大切|たいせつ}にする。
examples.english: To take care of limited resources.

examples.japanese: {人的|じんてき}{資源|しげん}を{活用|かつよう}する。

notes:
{資源|しげん} is composed of {資|し} (capital) + {源|げん} (source).

COMMON TYPES:
- {天然|てんねん}{資源|しげん}: natural resources
- {人的|じんてき}{資源|しげん}: human resources
- {鉱物|こうぶつ}{資源|しげん}: mineral resources
- {水|すい}{資源|しげん}: water resources
- {再生可能|さいせいかのう}{資源|しげん}: renewable resources
